chapter: New York studio and TV work
title: The first-call studio rhythm sections and chicken solos
summary: Hinton and Duvivier plus big-band drummers formed the core, and tenor players like King Curtis played chicken solos.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Studio work and jingles: New York session life

blocks.x: There was a core of people that were — what do they call it — first call?

Milt was there all the time. Milt and George Duvivier. I mean we had all jazz people. I mean the drummers were all from that, from the big bands, all from the big bands. And then once they got that eighth note feel, they were in.
And the tenor players all had to play those chicken solos — that’s what they called them.
And King Curtis was the champ, and Sam the Man Taylor.
